hook_text: A dry bean in a packet looks as dead as a stone. Add water and watch what happens.
clip_script: Gogo's kitchen. A dry bean, a packet of yeast, an egg. They look dead. Are they? Put the bean on wet cotton wool. Three days later, a root! Mix the yeast with warm water and sugar. Bubbles! The dough rises. Let a hen sit on a fertilised egg. Twenty-one days later, cheep cheep! All three were only resting. Water, warmth and food wake them up. But boil them and that is the end. Asleep is not the same as dead.
visual_style: Whiteboard kitchen shelf with a packet of beans, a packet of yeast and an egg; each one wakes up in turn, a shoot, bubbles, a chick.
mood: Surprising and warm, like a kitchen magic trick.
pacing: Three quick wake-ups, then the rule that ties them together.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and soak a bean on wet cotton wool at home.
